notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill Nevinyrral at instant speed.
description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Nine Lives and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
Nine Lives triggers. Holding priority, kill Nevinyrral at instant speed.
When Nevinyrral dies, it triggers, destroying all creatures, artifacts and/or enchantments.
Each opponent's Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, causing them to lose the game.
